findings.finding: The independent ADM series, as compiled by the broker, has Q3 2026 online tracking at or above the guide's run-rate: iGaming market +14% in Q3 with Lottomatica's share at 31.2% (Lottomatica iGaming GGR about +16%), and July iSport market GGR +33% on a favourable payout (about 1 point better YoY), so the Online division is consistent with the broker's +19% H2 GGR estimate.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 2026 beat (EBITDA expected at the upper end): +12.7% on 2026-05-06. Q2 2026 EBITDA about 2% above the broker estimate with guidance confirmed: -1.4% on 2026-07-28. Q3 2025 in line with a more precise guide: +3.3% on 2025-11-04 (Yahoo daily bars).
findings.original_quote: porta il terzo trimestre 2026 a +14% su base annua ... Con una quota di mercato pari a 31,2% nel trimestre ... [GGR Lottomatica] attorno a +16% su base annua
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced. The ADM monthly data are public, and 15+ analysts track them through Websim and Intermonte notes. What is not public is Lottomatica's own sports margin and its Aug-Sep iSport payout. If the market had priced a clear beat, the stock would not sit about 5% below its late-September level (EUR 27.10 average buyback price in the week of 21-25 Sep) with only +1.5% over 20 days.
findings.independence: https://www.websim.it/azioni/blue-chip/lottomatica-mercato-scommesse-anche-in-luglio-crescita-sostenuta/ (July iSport +33%, retail +58%, 2026-08-10) and https://www.websim.it/azioni/blue-chip/lottomatica-mercato-igaming-14-ad-agosto/ (August iGaming +14%, share 31.3%, 2026-09-04). findings.finding: The Q3 2025 comparison is demanding on sports: Q3 2025 adj. EBITDA of EUR 194.9m (+18%) was helped by an operator-favourable payout (August 2025 iSport payout 85.9% against 90.0%) and record September online share. The FY26 guide is at NORMALISED payout, after a EUR 17m YTD payout drag, so reported Q3 can print below the normalised figure even while the business runs on plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Payout-driven misses on Sports Franchise (H1 2026 revenue -1% on payout) did not stop the H1 print from being sold mildly (-1.4%). No clean case where the payout alone moved the stock.
findings.original_quote: Adjusted EBITDA ... Euro 194,9 milioni nel Q3 2025, +18% rispetto al Q3 2024
findings.why_not_priced: The comparison base and the normalised-payout basis are public, so this is largely priced. The open part is the Aug-Sep 2026 sports payout, which I could not find in any source. If the market were worried about it, sell-side previews would flag the payout risk; none was found.

findings.finding: The 2027 budget asks gaming for about 0.03% of GDP (over EUR 700m in 2027), and the measures are still unspecified as of 28 October. Options reported include a revised levy on online winnings (Lottomatica holds about 31% of online), a paid one-year extension of retail concessions (broker estimates already carry about EUR 80m of concession capex), and the Gratta e Vinci tender (no exposure). The 3 November call is management's first scheduled chance to quantify it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In the 2025 budget episode the stock fell on rumours of an online betting levy (trend-online, 'Lottomatica male. Nuovi rumor su manovra'). In October 2026 the stock slid from about EUR 27 to about EUR 24 while the DPB was being drafted, then recovered to EUR 25.8.
findings.original_quote: Ci attendiamo che la manovra includa una proroga onerosa di un anno delle concessioni retail ... Nelle nostre stime includiamo circa 80 milioni di euro di capex legati al rinnovo delle concessioni
findings.why_not_priced: The levy's form is unknown, so the market cannot price it beyond a discount. The October drawdown and partial recovery look like that discount. If an online winnings levy had been confirmed, broker estimates would have been cut and the stock would not have recovered 3.4% on 28 October. Whether the bill text or management comment lands inside the one-session window is uncertain, which is why this is sized small.

'The move is in the guide' (reiterated, median 2.3%) was weighed against 'too small about the move' and this name's real results-day moves (+15.0%, +12.7%, +3.3%, -1.4%); abs_move_pct was held at 4.0 and not cut
